extract_student_records.description: Retrieve a student's academic record by roll number, searched from indexed institutional spreadsheets.
extract_student_records.limitations: Requires a roll number stated in the request and the indexed spreadsheet directory to be present; honestly reports 'not found' or 'records unavailable' rather than returning simulated data.

fetch_drive_spreadsheet.description: Read rows from a Google Sheets spreadsheet by spreadsheet ID and range.
fetch_drive_spreadsheet.limitations: No Google service-account credentials are configured at uri_workspace/credentials.json; falls back to mock data until they are.

draft_institutional_note.description: Draft a concise NIT Sikkim administrative office noting from a request description.
draft_institutional_note.limitations: Drafting only; does not submit, approve, or file the noting anywhere.

draft_institutional_order.description: Draft a formal NIT Sikkim administrative Office Order from a request description.
draft_institutional_order.limitations: Drafting only; does not issue, sign, or distribute the order.

read_attached_file.description: Read the text of a file the user attached to this conversation (PDF including scanned/OCR, plain text, CSV, JSON, spreadsheet, image, or Word document), returning the extracted text as evidence for the Brain to reason from - never an answer URI composes itself.
read_attached_file.limitations: Reads only files the user actually attached to the current conversation; honestly reports when nothing is attached, when a file type has no text extractor, when a document contains no readable text, or when extraction fails, rather than inventing content.

gmail_search.description: Search the user's Gmail for messages matching an administrative query, returning subject/date/snippet as evidence for the Brain to reason from - never an answer URI composes itself.
gmail_search.limitations: Requires uri_workspace/credentials.json (a Google OAuth client secret) and a completed one-time OAuth consent; honestly reports when credentials are missing, authentication fails, or the search returns no results rather than inventing information.

gmail_find_draft.description: Search the user's existing Gmail drafts (read-only) for one relevant to the request, returning it as evidence for the Brain to reason from. URI cannot create, modify, send, or delete drafts through this capability.
gmail_find_draft.limitations: Requires the same Google OAuth credentials as gmail_search; reports 'not found' when Gmail is unavailable or when no relevant draft exists, and cannot distinguish those two cases from the underlying service's return value.

web_search.description: Search the public Internet for real, current information via a real search API, returning titles/URLs/content snippets as evidence for the Brain to reason from - never an answer URI composes itself.
web_search.limitations: Requires a configured TAVILY_API_KEY (see .env.example); honestly reports when the search service is unreachable, misconfigured, or returns no results rather than inventing information.

pc_system_optimization.description: Inspect and optimize this device's performance (e.g. startup programs, disk/temp cleanup, resource-heavy processes) with explicit user approval before any change.
pc_system_optimization.limitations: No execution adapter exists yet; this entry exists so URI can explain the gap honestly rather than pretend the capability is available. See the Controlled Self-Development architecture (research -> propose -> approve -> test -> approve -> execute -> verify -> rollback) for how this would eventually be built - none of that pipeline exists yet either.
